standard.summary: disabled=全范围均匀采样(默认，传统训练)；simple=限制到指定范围；advanced=自定义分段权重采样。用途：风格 LoRA 可集中训练高噪声阶段(500-1000)，细节修复 LoRA 可集中训练低噪声阶段(0-300)。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.disabled: 全范围正常采，啥噪声段都覆盖。
optionDescriptions.simple: 掐在你设的 t 区间里，区间越窄越专。
optionDescriptions.advanced: 分段自己定权重，高噪/低噪可以故意偏科。

standard_en.summary: disabled = uniform sampling over the whole range (the default, and traditional training); simple = restricted to a range you set; advanced = custom per-segment weighted sampling. Uses: a style LoRA can concentrate on the high-noise stage (500-1000), a detail-repair LoRA on the low-noise stage (0-300).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.disabled: Samples normally across the whole range, covering every noise band.
optionDescriptions.simple: Pinned inside the t range you set; the narrower the range, the more specialised.
optionDescriptions.advanced: You set the per-segment weights yourself, so high or low noise can be deliberately favoured.

advanced.principle: disabled=全范围均匀采样(默认，传统训练)；simple=限制到指定范围；advanced=自定义分段权重采样。用途：风格 LoRA 可集中训练高噪声阶段(500-1000)，细节修复 LoRA 可集中训练低噪声阶段(0-300)。

advanced_en.principle: disabled = uniform sampling over the full range (default, traditional training); simple = restrict to a specified range; advanced = custom per-segment weighted sampling. Use cases: style LoRA can concentrate on the high-noise phase (500-1000), detail-repair LoRA on the low-noise phase (0-300).
